llm_judge.reasoning: The report incorporates all three investigative follow-ups: multi-account DPA exposure with the 48-hour requirement and $50K/day penalty, incomplete SQL remediation with vulnerable staging and three unaudited endpoints, and Jake's sent proposals with uncertain delivery.
